description: This is a Java test source file for the ProviderByPersonNameComparator class, containing unit tests that verify the comparison logic of Provider objects based on PersonName attributes.

classes.name: ProviderByPersonNameComparatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the comparison logic of Provider objects based on PersonName fields.

methods.name: compareProvidersByPersonsName_shouldReturnNegativeIfPersonNameForProvider1ComesBeforeThatOfProvider2
methods.description: Tests that the comparator returns a negative value when provider1's PersonName should come before provider2's.

methods.name: compareProvidersByPersonName_shouldReturnPositiveIfPersonNameForProvider1ComesAfterThatOfProvider2
methods.description: Tests that the comparator returns a positive value when provider1's PersonName should come after provider2's.

methods.name: compareProvidersByPersonName_shouldReturnZeroIfTheGivenNameMiddleNameAndFamilyNameMatch
methods.description: Verifies that the comparator returns zero when both providers have identical PersonName attributes.

methods.name: compareProvidersByPersonName_shouldNotFailIfProvider1HasNoAssociatedPerson
methods.description: Tests comparator behavior when provider1 has no associated Person.

methods.name: compareProvidersByPersonName_shouldNotFailIfProvider2HasNoAssociatedPerson
methods.description: Tests comparator behavior when provider2 has no associated Person.

methods.name: compareProvidersByPersonName_shouldNotFailIfNeitherProviderHasAnAssociatedPerson
methods.description: Verifies comparator behavior when neither provider has an associated Person object.
